**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Ownership record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4392#issuecomment-7224554916

## What looks good

- The PR removes the 17 tracked `.pyc` blobs from the index: 16 in `site/tests/__pycache__/` and 1 in `site/tools/__pycache__/`.
- `.gitignore` adds `__pycache__/` and `*.pyc` for the whole tree. The comment names #4386.
- `docs/decisions/4386-pycache-ignore.md` uses the format of `docs/decisions/README.md`. It has the heading, the decision, the reason, the dropped option and the cost.
- The commit subject obeys Conventional Commits. The commit body and the PR body end with `Fixes #4386`. The body has `Changelog: none`.
- No file in the tree refers to a `.pyc` file or to a `__pycache__` folder (`git grep`).
- The PR changes no process file, no Rust code, no G-code, no geometry, no simulation and no UI. This is not a safety-tier review. No screenshots are necessary.

## Results, merged with main (locally)

Trial merge of the head `8e27d2e8e` with `upstream/main` `751a79b20`: clean, no conflicts.

- `git ls-files | grep -E '__pycache__|\.pyc$'` on the merged tree: 0 files.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: "nothing in crates/ changed: no tests to run". 0 steps, 0 failed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p "test_guide_icons.py"`: the run writes `site/tests/__pycache__/`. After the run, `git status --short --ignored site` shows only `!! site/tests/__pycache__/`. No tracked file changes.
- The same suite has 2 failures and 1 error. They are not from this PR. The failures compare `site/static/icons/op-rotary-*.png` with `assets/ui/`, and the error is the missing `zola` program. The PR does not change `site/static/` or `assets/ui/` (`git diff upstream/main HEAD -- site/static assets/ui` is empty), so main has the same result.

Extra suites run: none are applicable. The diff does not change `testdata/`, a fixture or golden directory, or importer code.

Goldens moved: none. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changed.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard` shows one tracked file that an ignore rule matches: `screenshot.png` at the root, from the older `/*.png` rule. This PR did not cause it. It is not in the scope of #4386.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
